decisions.reason: Displaying the entire tree changes the crop of the Page 30 photo but does not change which photos must be included or where they must be placed.
The Page 30 crop adjustment does not alter the document-wide layout, formatting, graphic-treatment coverage, or compaction rules.
The source concerns a photo on Page 30 and does not change the one-page letter, signature insertion, or handling of displaced letter photos.
Changing the visible extent of a tree in one photo does not affect the Agua Arc identity, colors, or logo.
The Page 30 photo crop does not change the background treatment specified for the cover, table of contents, appendix divider, or last page.
The source changes only photo cropping and has no effect on typeface or font-size consistency.
Showing the entire tree in a Page 30 photo does not reorder or otherwise change the fixed RFQ section sequence.
The crop adjustment does not add, remove, or resolve any required narrative section or subsection content.
The Page 30 tree-photo crop is unrelated to incorporation of the organization chart.
The source does not change the inclusion or replacement of proposal tables or the budget sheet.
Although the crop may be edited in Canva, the source does not change Canva ownership, editability, asset restrictions, reuse rights, or signature insertion.
The requested Page 30 crop adjustment does not establish any change to the document page-count target or layout-compaction rule.
